hooks.name: pre-tool-use
hooks.description: Before a shell, file write or iwe MCP tool: refuse a force push (KIRO_ALLOW_FORCE_PUSH=1), `iwe normalize` (IWE_ALLOW_NORMALIZE=1) and hand edits of generated files (KIRO_ALLOW_GENERATED_WRITE=1), and ask the user once when another Kiro session uses this working tree (docs/tooling/git-hooks.md).
